lines.zh: 我一路啃着走，边吃边挪。
lines.en: I munch as I go, moving and eating at once.
I crawl a little faster than my kin.
I head up the outer side of the twig.

lines.zh: 我每爬一步就嗅一下叶面。
lines.en: Every step, I sniff the leaf.
I travel from leaf tip to leaf base.
Falling doesn't scare me; I just climb back.

lines.zh: 我拱起腰，把身体送出去。
lines.en: I arch and send my body forward.

lines.zh: 我翻过一道卷起的叶边。
lines.en: I climb over a curled leaf edge.

lines.zh: 我的斑比别的同胞更浅。
lines.en: My marks are paler than my kin's.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方留着咬痕。
lines.en: Bite marks trail behind me.
I move to the sunny side; it's warmer there.
I go around a knot in the wood.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶滑到下一片。
lines.en: I slip down from one leaf to the next.
I pause and set my heading.
I edge along sideways, slowly.

lines.zh: 我边走边留下一道细丝。
lines.en: I leave a thin thread behind as I go.

lines.zh: 我抬着前半身，四处张望。
lines.en: I rear up my front half and look about.

lines.zh: 叶屑粘在我嘴边，我慢慢咽。
lines.en: Leaf bits cling to my mouth; I swallow slowly.
My segments swell one after another.
I stop where the veins cross.
I tap the leaf with my antennae.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶缝漏到我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight leaks through a gap onto me.
I draw my body into a half loop.
I'm listening to the sound inside the trunk.
My feet hold the leaf edge, still.
I rarely rest this long.
A shadow passed overhead.

lines.zh: 我探起头，嗅了嗅又趴回去。
lines.en: I lift my head, sniff, and lie back down.
You're blocking the light from above.

lines.zh: 你的指节离我的叶子太近。
lines.en: Your knuckles are too close to my leaf.
Are you going to pick me up?

lines.zh: 这片叶子我已经啃了一半。
lines.en: I've already eaten half this leaf.
I can crawl better than I look.

lines.zh: 你能把我放到另一棵树上吗。
lines.en: Could you set me on another tree?
The marks on my back are shifting.
You've snapped my twig.
I stay on just these few leaves.
I've ducked under the leaf.
I tighten every segment of my body.
I slip a short way along the leaf.
My body has gone soft.
I curl into a small ring.
I spit out a little fluid.
My feet don't grip as firmly.
I crawl deeper into the leaf.
I shudder once and stop.
My markings have dulled.

lines.zh: 伤在节缝里，我得缓一缓。
lines.en: The wound is between my segments; I need a moment.
Is this leaf tender enough?
Anything else, I won't touch.
That leaf in your hand — lower it a bit.
I can't leave the leaf for long.
That's not a leaf.
It bites well enough; I'll try it.

lines.zh: 你手上还带着别的东西。
lines.en: That's not all you're holding.
Let me sniff before I eat.
If the leaf drops, I lose my hold.
Thanks, but I want that one.
You bumped the twig and I swayed.
I slid off the leaf onto its stem.

lines.zh: 我的头撞到了你的指甲。
lines.en: My head knocked your nail.
I gripped and didn't fall.

lines.zh: 叶子弯下去，我滚回中间。
lines.en: The leaf bent and I rolled to the middle.
You moved, so I curled.
My thread caught me.
I slipped onto the back of your hand.
That bent the leaf's vein.
It took me a while to crawl back.
I'm looking for another caterpillar.
Its marks are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们爬到了同一根枝上。
lines.en: We ended up on the same twig.
It's half a leaf behind me.
We stop head to head.
It eats; I wait beside it.

lines.zh: 再过些日子就都不一样了。
lines.en: In a few more days everything will be different.
Its body is thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起晒了一个下午。
lines.en: We basked together all afternoon.
It crawled off and I didn't follow.
This leaf scrap I carry in my jaws.
I push it along, inch by inch.
I can't hold onto anything too big.
This is too heavy.
I bite it down a bit at a time.
What falls on the leaf is mine.
I drag it under the leaf.
I eat slowly, but I eat it all.
A dry twig isn't food.
I hide it in a fold of the leaf.
A shadow has fallen on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我把前三个体节撑起来。
lines.en: I lift my first three segments.
That's wrong. It isn't a leaf.
I crawl toward the underside.
Both pairs of my antennae snap straight.
I'll stop first, then decide.
The twig is shaking; I feel it.
I pull in and wait.
The leaf edge is close.

lines.zh: 我盯住那道爬上叶面的影子。
lines.en: I fix on the shadow climbing onto the leaf.
I keep my marks in the leaf's shade.
I wait without moving at all.
The leaf sways and I hold tight.
Its shadow is back.
I retreat toward the stem.
I'll stay pressed to the leaf.
A little deeper in and I'm safe.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶脉，把轮廓收小。
lines.en: I press to the vein and make my outline small.
When it leaves, I'll switch leaves.
I'm waiting for that moment.
I push with my head.
I bite into its skin.
That did almost nothing.
I was shoved into a roll.
I loop up and bump into it.
My jaws aren't made for this.
I curl up and guard my head.

lines.zh: 我几乎咬不穿任何东西。
lines.en: I can hardly bite through anything.
I retreat to the stem.
That hurt for a long while.
I come out from under a leaf.
My first bite was leaf.
I settle at a fork in the twig.
There are leaves everywhere in this forest.
I look up for the highest leaf.
The marks on me are still soft.
I grip a vein and plant myself.
I sniff at this new place.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的碎屑吹走。
lines.en: The wind blows the crumbs off me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬向有光的地方。
lines.en: I crawl slowly toward the light.
The heat sears and I curl up at once.
I fall off the branch into the grass.
Water soaks me and my feet won't move.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪掀翻了叶子。
lines.en: The blast flips the leaves over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过叶片，落在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the leaf beside me.

lines.zh: 一道魔力裹住我，我僵直了。
lines.en: Magic wraps me and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: The leaf is eaten through and I'm faint with hunger.

lines.zh: 白光一闪，整棵树都亮了。
lines.en: A white flash lights the whole tree.
There are no veins to grip here.
